integrity.computation_basis: Standalone standard-library Python 3 finite enumeration of all configurations for m=1,...,5.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit energy inequality, constructive descent, reversible ground-state hypercube junctions, exact cut-flow bound.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to equal positive part sizes and the precise closed-neighborhood asynchronous minority rule.
The mixing result is a lower bound, not an asymptotic or upper bound.
General parameter proofs are analytic; finite computations cover only m=1 through m=5.
Originality assessment is bounded best-knowledge and does not prove global uniqueness.
title: One communicating ground-state class and an exponential bottleneck for stochastic minority on balanced tripartite graphs
